sourceNote: Supplied by Robert on 3 November 2026. These are separate variants; Day 01 Version 2 is retained unchanged.

sections.title: Morning and the walk to school

rows.hanzi: 我每天早上醒来，然后起床，洗澡，换衣服。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang xǐnglái, ránhòu qǐchuáng, xǐzǎo, huàn yīfu.
rows.english: I wake up every morning, then get out of bed, take a shower, and change my clothes.

rows.hanzi: 然后我去厨房做早饭。
rows.pinyin: Ránhòu wǒ qù chúfáng zuò zǎofàn.
rows.english: Then I go to the kitchen to prepare breakfast.

rows.hanzi: 因为我不吃肉，所以我做素食炒饭。
rows.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ bù chī ròu, suǒyǐ wǒ zuò sùshí chǎofàn.
rows.english: Because I don’t eat meat, I make vegetarian fried rice.

rows.hanzi: 我也喜欢水果。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ yě xǐhuan shuǐguǒ.
rows.english: I also like fruit.

rows.hanzi: 吃完早饭以后，我准备出门去学校。
rows.pinyin: Chī wán zǎofàn yǐhòu, wǒ zhǔnbèi chūmén qù xuéxiào.
rows.english: After finishing breakfast, I get ready to leave home and go to school.

rows.hanzi: 因为我家离学校不太远，所以我走十分钟就到学校。
rows.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào bú tài yuǎn, suǒyǐ wǒ zǒu shí fēnzhōng jiù dào xuéxiào.
rows.english: Because my home isn’t very far from school, I can get there in just ten minutes on foot.

rows.hanzi: 我的课早上八点四十分开始。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ de kè zǎoshang bā diǎn sìshí fēn kāishǐ.
rows.english: My class starts at 8:40 a.m.

rows.hanzi: 十点十分，我们休息二十分钟。
rows.pinyin: Shí diǎn shí fēn, wǒmen xiūxi èrshí fēnzhōng.
rows.english: At 10:10, we have a twenty-minute break.

rows.hanzi: 我每天早上七点左右醒来。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang qī diǎn zuǒyòu xǐnglái.
rows.english: I wake up at around seven every morning.

rows.hanzi: 我通常在床上再躺十到十五分钟。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ tōngcháng zài chuáng shang zài tǎng shí dào shíwǔ fēnzhōng.
rows.english: I usually stay in bed for another ten to fifteen minutes.

rows.hanzi: 然后我起床，喝一杯温水。
rows.pinyin: Ránhòu wǒ qǐchuáng, hē yì bēi wēnshuǐ.
rows.english: Then I get out of bed and drink a glass of warm water.

rows.hanzi: 我洗澡，换衣服。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ xǐzǎo, huàn yīfu.
rows.english: I take a shower and change my clothes.

rows.hanzi: 然后我去厨房做早饭。
rows.pinyin: Ránhòu wǒ qù chúfáng zuò zǎofàn.
rows.english: Then I go to the kitchen and prepare breakfast.

rows.hanzi: 因为我不吃肉，所以我做素菜。
rows.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ bù chī ròu, suǒyǐ wǒ zuò sùcài.
rows.english: Because I don’t eat meat, I prepare vegetarian dishes.

rows.hanzi: 然后我吃早饭。
rows.pinyin: Ránhòu wǒ chī zǎofàn.
rows.english: Then I eat breakfast.

rows.hanzi: 早饭后，我准备出门。
rows.pinyin: Zǎofàn hòu, wǒ zhǔnbèi chūmén.
rows.english: After breakfast, I get ready to leave home.

rows.hanzi: 我出门去学校。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ chūmén qù xuéxiào.
rows.english: I leave home and go to school.

rows.hanzi: 我家离学校很近，走路只要十分钟。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn, zǒulù zhǐyào shí fēnzhōng.
rows.english: My home is close to school; walking takes only ten minutes.

rows.hanzi: 去学校的路上，我用微信点一杯咖啡。
rows.pinyin: Qù xuéxiào de lùshang, wǒ yòng Wēixìn diǎn yì bēi kāfēi.
rows.english: On the way to school, I order a coffee using WeChat.

rows.hanzi: 到学校以后，我在楼下的咖啡店取咖啡。
rows.pinyin: Dào xuéxiào yǐhòu, wǒ zài lóuxià de kāfēidiàn qǔ kāfēi.
rows.english: After arriving at school, I pick up my coffee at the coffee shop downstairs.

rows.hanzi: 然后我走进教室。
rows.pinyin: Ránhòu wǒ zǒujìn jiàoshì.
rows.english: Then I walk into the classroom.

rows.hanzi: 我的课早上八点四十分开始。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ de kè zǎoshang bā diǎn sìshí fēn kāishǐ.
rows.english: My class starts at 8:40 a.m.

rows.hanzi: 我十点十分休息二十分钟。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ shí diǎn shí fēn xiūxi èrshí fēnzhōng.
rows.english: At 10:10, I have a twenty-minute break.

rows.hanzi: 我十点半回去上课。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ shí diǎn bàn huíqù shàngkè.
rows.english: At 10:30, I return to class.

rows.hanzi: 中午十二点，我休息一个小时。
rows.pinyin: Zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn, wǒ xiūxi yí ge xiǎoshí.
rows.english: At noon, I have a one-hour break.

rows.hanzi: 我去吃午饭。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ qù chī wǔfàn.
rows.english: I go to have lunch.

rows.hanzi: 下一节课下午一点开始。
rows.pinyin: Xià yì jié kè xiàwǔ yì diǎn kāishǐ.
rows.english: The next class starts at 1 p.m.

rows.hanzi: 我下午两点半下课。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn bàn xiàkè.
rows.english: I finish class at 2:30 p.m.

rows.hanzi: 然后我回家。
rows.pinyin: Ránhòu wǒ huí jiā.
rows.english: Then I go home.

rows.hanzi: 回家以后，我开始远程工作。
rows.pinyin: Huí jiā yǐhòu, wǒ kāishǐ yuǎnchéng gōngzuò.
rows.english: After returning home, I start working remotely.

rows.hanzi: 我工作一会儿，再学一会儿中文。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ gōngzuò yíhuìr, zài xué yíhuìr Zhōngwén.
rows.english: I work for a while, then study Chinese for a while.

rows.hanzi: 我经常出去散步。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ jīngcháng chūqù sànbù.
rows.english: I often go out for a walk.

rows.hanzi: 我有时候散步半个小时，有时候散步两个小时。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shíhou sànbù bàn ge xiǎoshí, yǒu shíhou sànbù liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
rows.english: Sometimes I walk for half an hour, and sometimes for two hours.

rows.hanzi: 我在附近走走，有时候买点东西。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ zài fùjìn zǒuzou, yǒu shíhou mǎi diǎn dōngxi.
rows.english: I walk around the neighborhood and sometimes buy a few things.

rows.hanzi: 然后我回到家，继续工作。
rows.pinyin: Ránhòu wǒ huí dào jiā, jìxù gōngzuò.
rows.english: Then I return home and continue working.

rows.hanzi: 晚上我继续学中文。
rows.pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒ jìxù xué Zhōngwén.
rows.english: In the evening, I continue studying Chinese.

rows.hanzi: 睡觉前，我准备明天的课。
rows.pinyin: Shuìjiào qián, wǒ zhǔnbèi míngtiān de kè.
rows.english: Before going to bed, I prepare for tomorrow’s class.

rows.hanzi: 晚上十一点左右，我上床睡觉。
rows.pinyin: Wǎnshang shíyī diǎn zuǒyòu, wǒ shàngchuáng shuìjiào.
rows.english: I go to bed at around eleven.
